main_text.p: מרחמא Ch. Idem. Plur. cum Aff. מְרַחֲמוֹהִי Amici ejus, Gen.26.26. Alii,ut & Jonath.habent absq; מ, רַחֲמוֹהִי.
רַחֲמָא Ch.Gratia,misericordia, miseratio. Plur. רַחֲמִין. Miserationes: Item Viscera, ut Jer.31.20. Syr. [illegible, ~5 letters] Idem. Luc.1.78.Matth.5.7. ad Coloss.3.12.
רַחְמוּתָא רַחְמוּ, רַחְמוֹרֵת Ch.Amor, dilectio, amicitia, Prov.5.19. &17.9. Ezech.23.12. Misericordia, Psalm.29.10.
רַחְמָתָא Ch.Idem,Cum Aff. רַחְמָתָךְ Amor tuus, Cant. 4.9. Eccles.9.1.
[illegible, ~5 letters] Syr. Idem,ad Hebr.2.17. Jac.5.11. Plural.

רַחֲמָא [illegible, ~5 letters] Syr. Misericordia, Intimus, Viscerum affectus, Resp. Graec. σπλάγχνα Viscera, ad Philipp.2.1.& Col.3.12.

page.notes: Most Syriac words are too small or blurred to read with certainty and are marked as illegible. The Hebrew and Greek are copied as printed where legible. The Hebrew catchword at the lower right is רחץ. Some Hebrew vowel points in the entries are doubtful.
